rule: file-depth cut: every list (the BM25 leg, the dense leg and the fused list) keeps chunks in rank order until it holds retrieve_k distinct files (or its candidates run out); metrics are unchanged.
as_coded: a list keeps its chunks in rank order and stops right after the chunk that brings it to retrieve_k distinct files, so a later chunk of a file it already holds is not kept; a leg's candidates are every chunk it returns when asked for all chunks of the index (BM25 returns only chunks that share a term with the question); the fused list is the two cut legs through rrf_score_map and the stable sort by score InMemoryHybridIndex.retrieve uses, cut again; files are taken in the order of their first chunk
default_path: unchanged: InMemoryHybridIndex, the served SQL and every committed row keep the top retrieve_k chunks; the file-depth rows are added beside them

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap over queries, one index matrix shared by all configs (paired deltas)

reproduces.compared: every field of each row's retrieval block (rounded means, by category)
